name: Asahina Subaru
source:
Birth Date: 1990/09/21.
Occupation: 2nd year student in Meiji University / Professional Basketball player.

Subaru is the 9th son of the Asahina family. He’s a second year student in Meiji University who has been dedicating his life to basketball ever since he was small. Because of his stoic and upright personality, combined with the fact that he’s absolutely not interested in anything other than sports, Subaru doesn’t have any experience with women. He has no idea how to behave around [url=/c10574]Ema[/url], and this often leads to an awkward situation between them.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/04/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-subaru/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
